name: What should I do first if I want a shower niche installed?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want a shower niche installed?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A shower niche should be planned before wall surfaces are closed, not cut into a finished shower casually. Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate the niche with the bathroom layout, framing, waterproofing system, plumbing, electrical work, and tile pattern as part of a broader bathroom remodel. The exact location depends on wall depth, plumbing lines, exterior-wall conditions, user height, and whether the niche must avoid studs or valves.

Key factors:
- Keep it reachable without standing directly under the shower spray.
- Check for plumbing, wiring, vents, and structural framing before opening the wall.
- Size the opening around the selected tile and grout joints.

Practical guidance: Bring preferred tile, bottle dimensions, and storage needs to the design consultation. Request a drawing or 3D visualization showing the niche height, width, shelf layout, and finished dimensions before construction begins. This is especially useful when coordinating a custom bathroom in San Diego, Chula Vista, or nearby communities.

Elite Remodeling & Design can address the niche during the design-to-construction planning process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan the niche before the shower walls are closed. Confirm its location against framing, plumbing, wiring, user height, bottle sizes, tile dimensions, and waterproofing details. Elite Remodeling & Design can include those decisions in the bathroom design and construction plan.
